The M1 goal: present class schedule A and ask the five questions one by one, with independent check-and-read and a correct answer within 20 seconds after each question. Each question is 1 opportunity and each round is 5 opportunities. I = correct independent location; H = correct after an extra keyword prompt; W = wrong or overtime; a blank has an unknown reason and is not correct. The actual observation environment was not fully recorded and comparable conditions are not assumed.
